title: Mobility Equipment Quality Review Standard — Recurrence Review on Caster Claims
content:
# Recurrence Review Allowance — Caster Claims on Mobility Equipment

A recurrence-review allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty tire or caster replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the number of repair estimate requests on the chair: 2 units for 3 or more, 1 unit for exactly 2, and nothing for fewer.

| Repair estimate requests on the chair (any status) | Recurrence-review allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | none |
| exactly 2 | 1 unit |
| 3 or more | 2 units |

**Hypothetical cases.** One request on file: none. Two requests: 1 unit. Three requests: 2 units, and a fourth request leaves it at 2 units.
